modes.run: node scripts/mpd-bg.mjs run --log <workspace-path> [--pid <path>] [--cwd <dir>] -- <cmd> [args…] — opens the log file, hands it to the child as stdout+stderr (NEVER a pipe), prints pid + log path, writes `<log>.pid`, returns immediately; documented to be started INSIDE a managed background job
modes.probe: node scripts/mpd-bg.mjs probe <pidfile|pid> — kernel-only liveness (kill(pid, 0)); RUNNING exit 0 · DEAD exit 1 · NO-PID-FILE exit 2; it never greps a command line, so the 'probe's own cmdline matches' trap is structurally impossible
